name: Humanitarian funding gap
summary: WFP is cutting Gaza food aid for about 500,000 people over a $450m gap; Sudan operation about one-third funded in Sept
state: WFP said on 19 Oct that about half a million people in Gaza would lose food assistance as its monthly caseload falls from 1.6m to 1.1m, and that it needs $450m for Gaza and the West Bank to March 2027 (WFP). On 14 Sep WFP said its Sudan operation was about one-third funded, and IOM warned that the humanitarian system there could collapse (UN News). Searches on 8 Nov found no formal large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country.
for_you: People relying on WFP rations in Gaza, the West Bank and Sudan are most exposed. Aid agencies are choosing whom to keep supporting as budgets shrink.
rubric_hit: Watch: major ration cuts announced (WFP Gaza caseload 1.6m to 1.1m). Alert line not met: no pipeline break forcing large-scale suspension found as of 8 Nov.

sources.title: WFP — Funding cuts force WFP to drastically reduce lifesaving assistance in Gaza
UN News — UN agencies warn humanitarian system in Sudan 'could collapse'

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
